description: This file defines the interface for the rbusMessage subsystem, including the data structures, enums, callback types, and function declarations for sending, receiving, and managing message listeners within the rbus publish/subscribe framework.

methods.name: rbusMessage_AddPrivateListener
methods.description: Adds a private listener for a specific topic expression to receive messages directly.

methods.name: rbusMessage_AddListener
methods.description: Adds a general message listener for a specified topic expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_RemovePrivateListener
methods.description: Removes a private listener for a given topic expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener for a specified topic expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_RemoveAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all message listeners from the handle.

methods.name: rbusMessage_HasListener
methods.description: Checks if there is a listener registered for a specific topic.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the specified handle with given options.

ctags.name: RBUS_MESSAGE_CONFIRM_RECEIPT
ctags.pattern: /^  RBUS_MESSAGE_CONFIRM_RECEIPT = 1     \/**< The message is sent, blocking until a response$/

ctags.name: RBUS_MESSAGE_NONE
ctags.pattern: /^  RBUS_MESSAGE_NONE = 0, \/**< The message is sent non-blocking with no$/

ctags.name: data
ctags.pattern: /^    uint8_t const*  data;       \/**< The binary data being sent *\/$/

ctags.name: length
ctags.pattern: /^    int             length;     \/**< The binary data length *\/$/

ctags.name: topic
ctags.pattern: /^    char const*     topic;      \/**< The topic the message is sent to *\/$/
